name: Julia Lindum
source:
Julia Lindum is a member of the Leazas Royal Guard, formed from the strongest women within the military and dedicated to protecting the Royal Family. Unfortunately, Julia didn't attain the rank of Royal Guard due to her strength but instead because of her family's connections.

[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Julia_Lindum]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
